summary: Admit the provider-neutral promotion and advertising management runtime with guarded preview, approval-bound intents, reconciliation and explicit live qualification boundaries.

impacts.evidence: Rules, previews, intents, drifts and kill switch are scoped to authenticated organization/workspace and stored behind forced RLS.
Only bounded SKU references, monetary facts, digests and normalized states are retained; credentials, raw responses and PII are excluded.
Rules, preview, apply, operation, reconciliation and kill-switch routes are additive OpenAPI operations with regenerated SDKs.
Approved intents are durable command evidence; future remote worker transitions remain subject to canonical outbox/inbox event rules.
Promotion/advertising writes use a typed connector port and separate promotions.manage/ads.manage capabilities.
Migration 53 is expand-only, backup-gated, bounded and adds tenant RLS for rules, previews, operations, drifts and controls.
Apply requires matching approval and idempotency; MCP is preview-only and no secret or raw provider payload crosses the boundary.
Floor/margin/freshness guards run before apply and a durable operation remains qualification_required without remote evidence.
Preview digest, rule version, approval reference, operation state and reconciliation drift preserve the decision chain.
Operation idempotency is unique per tenant/workspace; unknown and read-after-write mismatches become append-only drifts.
No caller-controlled egress is added; concrete remote writes remain in qualified connector adapters.
UI and API expose blocked rows, operation states, reconciliation findings and kill-switch state with bounded pagination.
Kill switch and capability disablement stop new writes; immutable evidence is retained and migration has no destructive down path.
Core/API tests, OpenAPI parity, generated SDK, frontend build and synthetic qualification cover the repository boundary.
